title: HR Administrator, Temporary to Permanent Opportunity
description:
Job Title: HR Administrator
Location: Atherstone
Contract Type: Temporary with the view to move into a permanent position
Working Pattern: Full Time, Monday to Friday, 9am - 5pm.

Daily Pay: £112

After initial training Hybrid working - 2 days from home 3 in the office.

Our client, a non for profit organisation making a real difference to lives across the Midlands, is seeking a dedicated and organised HR Administrator to join their small and dynamic human resources team. This exciting opportunity is perfect for individuals with strong administrative skills and a keen eye for detail, ready to make a significant impact on the organisation's success!

Key Responsibilities:
- Maintain accurate employee records and ensure HR compliance.
- Manage HR and recruitment inboxes, responding to and escalating queries as required.
- Support HR projects, meetings, and training initiatives.
- Coordinate recruitment activities, from vacancy advertising, interview support to onboarding of new staff.
- Manage employee lifecycle activities, including contractual changes, probation reviews, and flexible working requests.
- Coordinate learning and development programmes and monitor training compliance.
- Provide first-line HR guidance and support to managers and employees.
- Support disciplinary and grievance processes, ensuring accurate documentation and case preparation.

Experience and Skills Required:
- CIPD Level 3 qualification or proven experience in human resources and/or administrative roles preferred.
- Familiarity with HR platforms and ATS tools is desirable.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, for effective stakeholder engagement.
- Excellent organisational abilities with the capability to manage multiple priorities.
- Professional, confidential, and adaptable with a resilient attitude towards challenging situations.
- Attention to detail and accuracy while working at pace.

This role presents an engaging environment where organisational skills and attention to detail are highly valued. The HR Administrator will be integral in supporting HR functions through efficient data management and effective communication strategies.

If you are passionate about human resources and want to contribute to a fulfilling and supportive workplace, this opportunity could be the perfect fit Apply Today!

title: HR Assistant
description:
JOB PURPOSE

The post holder will provide extensive, end-to-end recruitment support, from initial application through to interview, appointment, and induction. This includes supporting recruitment campaigns, coordinating interviews, attending recruitment events where required, and ensuring all safer recruitment documentation is completed in line with organisational policy, Ofsted requirements, and regulatory standards.

In addition, the role will provide a wide range of high-quality administrative and office support to the Centres, there may be times when your role will require reception duties to support with office cover.

The primary focus of this job is to provide high quality administrative assistance within the HR Team. There will be an emphasis on personnel record management and recruitment.

We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with a can-do attitude, who can work accurately under pressure and prioritise high volumes of work.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

To support the HR Team, you will:
- Provide high-volume recruitment administration support, ensuring a positive and professional candidate experience throughout
- Support recruitment activity from application stage through to appointment, including advertising vacancies, coordinating shortlisting processes, and tracking candidate progress
- Draft, update, and maintain job descriptions and adverts in line with safer recruitment guidance and Ofsted regulations
- Coordinate and support first- and second-stage interviews, including preparing interview packs, schedules, and documentation
- Support managers with recruitment logistics and, where required, attend interviews or recruitment events to provide administrative and practical support
- Maintain accurate recruitment trackers and spreadsheets to evidence progress, compliance, and decision-making
- Create and issue offer letters and contracts for new starters, and manage contractual changes for existing staff
- Ensure all new starter documentation is completed fully and accurately prior to start dates
- Chase and process safer recruitment checks in line with policy, including references, employment history gaps, medical fitness, qualifications, and DBS applications and renewals
- Participate in safer recruitment meetings and contribute to ongoing improvements in recruitment processes
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date personnel files and probation records
- Collate and maintain diversity and equality monitoring information
- Ensure compliance with GDPR, including secure storage of documents and appropriate processing of leaver records
- Minute meetings as required
- Support staff welfare administration, including communicating staff benefits
- Update sickness records and support managers with Return-to-Work processes
- Respond to HR-related email enquiries appropriately and professionally
- Communicate effectively with senior leaders, managers, staff, service users, and external professionals
- When required support the office with cover to answer calls ensuring they are directed to the most suitable person in a professional manner. And answer the door, complying with safeguarding procedures, directing visitors to where they should be
- Undertake other HR administrative duties as required

Benefits of working at Dudley Lodge:
- Continuous training and professional development opportunities
- Staff wellbeing events throughout the year
- Team building days
- Employee Assistance Programme - this is a scheme run by Dudley Lodge for its employees. It enables staff to gain access to qualified advisors for a wide range of services day or night.
- Cash plan - After 1 year's continuous employment, you can opt for free cover under this Cash Plan policy.
- A pension scheme with Standard Life, Dudley Lodge contributes 5% towards your pension, also matching additional employee contributions up to 7.5%. The company will increase its contribution to 10% after an employee has reached their 10 years' service, on condition employees contribute the same.
- Life Assurance - Group Life Assurance Policy with Unun Life. The scheme provides a tax-free benefit to all permanent employees, paying a lump sum amount of 2 x salary in the event of death in service.
- Free tea, coffee, water and fruit for all staff
- Enhanced holidays:
- 22 days plus 8 bank holidays - up to 5 years continuous employment
- 27 days plus 8 bank holidays - up to 10 years continuous employment
- 32 days plus 8 bank holidays - over 10 years continuous employment
- Flu Vaccine: For Staff that do not qualify for the flu vaccine through the NHS
- Bike (Cycle) Scheme

Dudley Lodge is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and vulnerable adults and expect all staff and volunteers to share this commitment.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons.

Candidates must be eligible to work in the UK. We regret to inform you that we do not offer sponsorship for this position.

Closing date until sufficient applications are received- previous applicants need not apply.

title: HR Assistant
description:
This is an excellent opportunity to join a supportive and friendly HR consultancy team based in Warwick, providing high-quality administrative support across a varied client base. The role would suit a highly organised, detail-focused administrator who enjoys working in a busy, people-focused environment and is keen to build a long-term career in HR. Previous HR experience would be beneficial but is not essential, as full support, training and exposure to a wide range of HR matters will be provided.

Why Join Us

You will be joining a collaborative team where no two days are the same, gaining hands-on experience across employee relations, recruitment administration, HR documentation, client systems and general HR support. The role offers the chance to learn from experienced HR professionals, attend meetings alongside HR Advisors and develop practical HR knowledge while contributing to meaningful work for clients.

Training and Progression: Training and support will be provided, with the opportunity to develop HR knowledge and progress within the role.

Job Purpose

The role of the job is to provide excellent administrative support to the HR Advice team, helping to deliver a responsive, accurate and professional service to clients while developing practical HR knowledge and experience.

Main Duties
- Drafting HR letters as directed by the team including, disciplinary invites, grievance invites, outcome letters, letters of concern, resignation letters, flexible working letters etc.
- Drafting contracts and offer letters.
- Providing an effective service for our clients.
- Attending meetings with a HR Advisor to develop knowledge and experience.
- Answering incoming calls, taking details and supporting the clients where able to or providing accurate messages to the team in a timely manner.
- Support recruitment campaigns for clients, including drafting job adverts, shortlisting candidates and arranging interviews
- Uploading advice to the CRM system
- Liaising with third party providers e.g. occupational health, DBS
- Supporting the team with administration in relation to clients HR systems
- Note taking during meetings and note typing of meetings and recordings
- Supporting the team with creation and updating of handbooks, policies and contacts for clients

Qualifications and Experience Required for This Role

We are particularly interested in hearing from strong administrators who are highly organised, accurate and keen to develop a career within HR. HR experience would be advantageous, but it is not essential for the right person.
- Outstanding business organisational skills
- HR experience would be advantageous but is not essential.
- Strong administrator
- Self-motivated, able to take initiative and use sound judgment in day-to-day decision making
- Customer-focused with a 'can do' attitude
- Ability to work to tight and often conflicting deadlines in a fast paced working environment

title: Part Time Website Content Coordinator

Website Content Coordinator

We are working on behalf of esteemed organisation, who are recruiting a creative and user-focused Website Content Coordinator to support one of the organisation's most significant digital transformation projects. This is an exciting opportunity to play a leading role in reviewing, rewriting and creating engaging website content that ensures their audience can find information quickly, access services easily and connect with everything the organisation has to offer.

You will also collaborate with colleagues across the organisation and the website project team to ensure content is clear, accessible, accurate and aligned with user needs, research insights and Warwick SU's brand.

The role is part-time at 20 hours per week. There are no fixed working days: the employer is happy to be flexible depending on the successful candidate and their needs, including considering shorter working days across the week. The business has a hybrid working policy with flexibility to work from home dependent on operational requirements.

Role and responsibilities:

- Write, edit and proofread high-quality website copy that reflects the organisations tone of voice, brand values and accessibility standards.
- Work closely with colleagues across the organisation to gather information, understand services and translate complex information into clear, student-friendly content.
- Apply user research, content strategy and digital best practice to improve website usability, navigation and overall user experience.
- Collaborate with the website project team to ensure content aligns with the new website structure, design, user journeys and project milestones.

- Contribute to content governance processes, editorial standards and sustainable workflows that support long-term website maintenance.
- Build positive relationships across departments and help ensure website content remains accurate, relevant and up to date.

Skills and experience required:
- Demonstrable experience writing, editing and proofreading content for websites or other digital channels.
- Experience managing complex content projects involving multiple stakeholders.
- Experience gathering information from subject matter experts and translating it into engaging content for target audiences.
- Experience reviewing and improving content for usability, readability and accessibility.
- Exceptional written communication and copywriting skills, with excellent attention to detail.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.
- Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to work collaboratively across an organisation.
- Understanding of digital content best practice, including accessibility and user-centred content design.
- Proactive, self-motivated and able to work independently, with a curious and analytical approach to understanding user needs.
- Experience of website redevelopment or digital transformation projects and familiarity with content management systems would be advantageous.

Benefits:
- Pro rota holiday entitlement based on 22 days annual leave including Bank Holidays and additional closure days
- Enhanced pension scheme
- Wellbeing programme
- Onsite parking
- BUPA cash plan
- Employee assistance programme

Interviews are scheduled for week commencing 21st and 28th September 2026.

If you are looking for a creative digital content role where you can make an impact, then please apply for this Website Content Coordinator opportunity.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant

Location: Head Office
Salary: £28,000 - £30,000
Contract: Permanent

The Opportunity

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Finance Assistant to join a busy finance team within a growing organisation. This role plays an important part in supporting the smooth running of day-to-day financial operations, ensuring transactions are processed accurately and within agreed deadlines.

While the primary focus will be within Accounts Payable, the successful candidate will also gain exposure to Accounts Receivable and Treasury activities, making this a varied position with opportunities to broaden your finance knowledge.

Working closely with the wider finance function, you'll be involved in invoice processing, expense management, reconciliations, ledger postings, payment support and resolving finance-related queries.

Key ResponsibilitiesAccounts Payable & Expenses
- Administer and manage the expense system, including reviewing submissions and processing payments.
- Ensure supporting receipts are obtained for company card transactions and accurately recorded within the accounting system.
- Process invoices promptly and allocate costs appropriately, including invoices requiring multiple coding entries.
- Maintain accurate nominal ledger postings and day-to-day transaction processing.
- Support payment runs through statement reconciliations and supplier account reviews.
- Provide cover for payment processing during annual leave periods and peak workloads.

Financial Administration
- Maintain accurate records within the organisation's job costing system and investigate any missing documentation.
- Ensure invoices are processed for projects or units approaching completion.
- Support Accounts Receivable and Treasury activities when required.
- Liaise with external stakeholders to resolve finance-related queries.
- Assist with ad hoc finance tasks and analysis as required by the wider team.

About You

We're looking for someone who is highly organised, detail-focused and comfortable working both independently and collaboratively.

You will ideally have:
- A good understanding of double-entry bookkeeping principles.
- Strong Excel skills, including functions such as Pivot Tables, VLOOKUPs, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS and conditional formatting.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- A proactive and positive approach to work.
- The ability to manage competing priorities within a fast-paced environment.
- A willingness to learn and develop professionally.

Desirable Experience
- Exposure to Sage 200 software.
- Knowledge of Excel VBA/macros.
- Experience working within a multi-site or multi-contract environment.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary of £28,000-£30,000.
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Option to buy and sell annual leave.
- Pension scheme.
- Health cashback and employee assistance support.
- Free onsite parking.
- Access to an onsite gym.
- The opportunity to develop your career within a growing business.

At Gleeson Recruitment Group, we embrace inclusivity and welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We are proud to be a disability confident employer.

By applying you will be registered as a candidate with Gleeson Recruitment Limited. Our Privacy Policy is available on our website and explains how we will use your data.
